Solana address lookup table interpreter APIs for resolving indirect transaction account references.

# Purpose
This header defines a small ALUT interpreter for Solana transactions. It declares `fd_alut_interp_t`, which stores the transaction, its serialized payload, the slot hash deque, the current lookup table index, and counters for writable and read-only indirect accounts. The functions `fd_alut_interp_new`, [`fd_alut_interp_delete`](<#fd_alut_interp_delete>), [`fd_alut_interp_done`](<#fd_alut_interp_done>), and [`fd_alut_interp_next`](<#fd_alut_interp_next>) create the interpreter, manage its lifetime, test for completion, and resolve one address lookup table entry at a time. [`fd_alut_interp_next`](<#fd_alut_interp_next>) validates the lookup table account, owner, data format, and index range, then writes the resolved account addresses into the output array and returns a runtime status code.
